description: The seven districts of Waterloo Region, one row each, with their 1 July 2025 population estimate, the area of their boundary polygon, the resulting population density, and the point used to place each label on the map.
source: Statistics Canada Table 17-10-0155-01 (population estimates, 1 July, by census subdivision, 2021 boundaries); Statistics Canada 2021 census subdivision cartographic boundary file lcsd000b21a_e (boundaries)
notes: Area is Statistics Canada's published 2021 census land area, which excludes inland water. The same seven rows with their boundary polygons attached are committed alongside as districts.geojson, which is what the map is drawn from; it is not part of this bundle because the bundle holds tabular formats only.

description: The four townships, one row each, with the number of cattle on their farms and the number of people living in them on 11 May 2021, census day for both the Census of Agriculture and the Census of Population.
source: Statistics Canada Table 32-10-0370-01 (cattle inventory on farms, 2021 Census of Agriculture); Statistics Canada Table 98-10-0002-01 (population and dwelling counts, 2021 census)
sample: None (Census of Agriculture, every farm; census short form, full count)
notes: Cattle are published for census consolidated subdivisions, groups of neighbouring census subdivisions; each of the four townships is one on its own, under its own census subdivision code, so these figures are the townships exactly. The figures are the table's "Total cattle": calves, steers, heifers, cows and bulls.
